text:
Hello Ms Wälti,

I'm getting in touch about my claim from June, because I haven't heard anything since I reported it and I'd like to move it along.

There's no bike involved. The rack on the back of the car was empty that day, and my bike was at home the whole time.

Nothing about this needed doing in a hurry, either. There was no danger that would have made me act before getting your instructions, so I've simply been waiting.

I do have the extra cover for simple theft away from home. I added it in January 2024, when I started commuting by car, and I've paid for it ever since.

On Tuesday 16 June 2026 I drove to Rapperswil for a dentist's appointment and parked in a side street near the lake, car locked. My work bag was on the back seat with my laptop, my tablet and a pair of noise-cancelling headphones. When I came back after about an hour and a half, the rear side window was smashed in and the bag had gone. Altogether it's about CHF 9,050.

The smashed window is still exactly as the thief left it, splinters on the seat and all. I've kept the car in my garage since then and haven't had anything repaired or cleaned, so if you or anyone else would like to see it, it's all still there.

I've attached my policy, which shows the extra theft cover, and the confirmation CSS sent me when I reported the claim.

Thanks and best regards,
Paul Wyss
Mattenweg 8, Uster
